name: traceability-check
description: Checks that tests Claude commits carry a requirement tag (Robot Framework and Playwright), and audits the repo on request

tagPattern.title: Requirement tag pattern
tagPattern.description: Regular expression (case-insensitive) a tag must match to count as a requirement link. Playwright's leading @ is ignored.

mode.title: When a test has no requirement tag
mode.description: block: refuse the commit. warn: let it through and tell Claude and you.
